entities.summary: Bernarda Ferreira de Lacerda was a Portuguese scholar, writer and playwright. She was born in Porto in about 1595 and died in 1644, and was celebrated in verse by both Manuel de Gallegos and Lope de Vega, suggesting that she was highly regarded as a poet by her male peers.
